params.body:
## Why

A source gets a page on gentells.com only when a post on the site or a report's source list cites it. A text made outside both, such as a dossier written with an assistant, links straight to its publishers. Neither Ask nor the Gentells MCP could turn such a link into a Gentells link.

The guide also said Ask does not read the web, while Ask has web search for the team.

## What

- `packages/core/kept-sources.mjs`: an editor or admin hands over addresses (at most 60 in one request) and gets each one's page on gentells.com back. A page the Observatory holds is reused, a new one is read once under "Cited by the author", and one that cannot be read is held by its address and marked unread, as a report's sources are.
- `source_links` (read), `source_keep` and `source_unkeep` (change) in Ask. A change is shown first and runs on `confirm: true`, goes by the role, and is written down, like the other tools.
- Refused: a competitor, a source read for inspiration only, and a page of Gentells itself. Each redirect is checked before it is followed, so a link that leads on to one of those is not read either.
- A title handed over names only a page that could not be read. It never becomes the signal's text. A page without a date gets none.
- The page says nothing of who kept it or for what.
- Taking one off deletes the signal only when keeping made it and no post, report or trend uses it. Undoing a report's sources leaves a kept page alone (`packages/core/signal-use.mjs`).
- Reading starts no new page after 25 seconds; what was not reached comes back as `later`, with nothing kept for it.
- `POST /internal/desk-tools`: the same three tools for an assistant connected to gentells.com/mcp, in the name of the person the site signed in. Its own token, `DESK_TOOLS_TOKEN`, as the newsletters have: the projection token only reads. Unset means closed.
- The guide and Ask's note: what this does, and that Ask can look on the web and says which part came from there.

## Checked

- `test/kept-sources.test.mjs` (new), `test/ask-acts.test.mjs`. Full suite 1817 of 1817, `tsc` clean.
- A list of 51 publisher addresses against a throwaway database with real reads: 51 links, 49 pages read, 2 held unread (one answered 403, one came back empty).
- Not tried: the site and the pipeline together on production.

## After merge

Ask works with the deploy. For the MCP, set `DESK_TOOLS_TOKEN` in the pipeline's `.env` and the same value in the site's, restart the pipeline and cache the site's config again. The site change is its own pull request ("The team's assistant gets Gentells links for sources through /mcp"). Either order works.
params.title: Ask and the Gentells MCP give a text's sources their Gentells links
